column4: Visit note | 2025-05-31 11:30 AM | Dr. Zahid Hasan, Gastroenterology | Patient: Afsana Khatun, 52, female. Mrs. Khatun comes in complaining that she suffers from urgent loose stools every morning with little pain, alternating between loose and hard stools, bloating, and distress that worsens with stress. She works as a bank officer and notes that her symptoms flare during long commutes through traffic in Sylhet. She reports no other major illnesses. On examination: pain score 3/10, BP 127/85 mmHg, pulse 77 bpm, weight 75 kg. Abdomen is soft without tenderness. Assessment: Irritable bowel syndrome. Plan: no new medicine was prescribed. She was advised to eat regular meals, keep a food diary, and reduce tea, fizzy drinks, and beans. Follow-up in 6 weeks with the food diary.

Visit note | 2025-06-01 10:00 AM | Dr. Zahid Hasan, Gastroenterology | Patient: Rakib Khan, 47, male. Mr. Khan explains that his symptoms are worse with stress, accompanied by bloating and stools that switch between loose and hard. He works as a security guard and mentions this has been worse since starting a high-pressure job in Keraniganj. He has no comorbid medical conditions. On examination: pain score 6/10, BP 113/77 mmHg, pulse 76 bpm, weight 51 kg. Abdominal examination is unremarkable. Assessment: Irritable bowel syndrome. Plan: no new medicine was prescribed. He was advised to eat regular meals, keep a food diary, and reduce tea, fizzy drinks, and beans. Follow-up in 6 weeks with the food diary.

Visit note | 2025-06-02 09:30 AM | Dr. Tahmina Begum, Dermatology | Patient: Mostafa Miah, 21, male. Mr. Miah reports having pimples and blackheads on his face alongside marks left after previous breakouts. He works as a CNG auto-rickshaw driver and states his skin became worse since working in a hot kitchen in Old Dhaka. He is otherwise healthy with no chronic illnesses. On examination: about 16 inflamed spots on the face, BP 123/86 mmHg, pulse 83 bpm, weight 61 kg. Skin shows papules and comedones without deep cysts. Assessment: Acne vulgaris. Plan: no new medicine was prescribed. He was advised to wash his face twice daily with a gentle cleanser and avoid squeezing spots. Follow-up in 2 months.

Visit note | 2025-06-02 11:00 AM | Dr. Lubna Rahman, Endocrinology | Patient: Habib Karim, 59, male. Mr. Karim states he has been working indoors all day and suffers from aching bones and muscle cramps. He is a retired civil servant and mentions these issues started after staying indoors during a long illness in Mirpur. He denies any prior chronic medical conditions. On examination: vitamin D level 13 ng/mL, BP 110/75 mmHg, pulse 92 bpm, weight 89 kg. Joints and muscles show no swelling or acute tenderness. Assessment: Vitamin D deficiency. Plan: no new medicine was prescribed. He was advised to get 20 minutes of morning sunlight daily and eat eggs and fish. Follow-up in 3 months with a repeat vitamin D level.

Visit note | 2025-06-10 11:30 AM | Dr. Towhid Alam, ENT | Patient: Gautam Paul, 61, male. Mr. Paul presents with a constantly blocked nose and snoring with little sneezing, and notes his symptoms are worse with dust. He works as a delivery rider and shares that it worsened since keeping a cat at home in Wari. He has a history of Hypothyroidism. On examination: about 3 sneezing fits a day, BP 131/81 mmHg, pulse 90 bpm, weight 85 kg. Nasal mucosa appears pale and boggy. Assessment: Allergic rhinitis. Plan: no new medicine was prescribed. He was advised to avoid dust, wear a mask when cleaning, and wash bedding weekly. Follow-up in 1 month.

Visit note | 2025-06-12 03:00 PM | Dr. Tanvir Ahmed, General Medicine | Patient: Rashid Matubbar, 33, male. Mr. Matubbar explains that he is getting breathless on the stairs, experiencing brittle nails, and looking pale. He works as a tailor and notes his complaints worsened after a long spell of poor meals while living alone in Gulshan. He has a known history of Bronchial asthma. On examination: haemoglobin 9.6 g/dL, BP 130/73 mmHg, pulse 75 bpm, weight 77 kg. Conjunctivae are pale, and chest is clear. Assessment: Iron deficiency anaemia. Plan: no new medicine was prescribed. He was advised to eat more lentils, spinach, liver, and eggs, and avoid tea within an hour of meals. Follow-up in 6 weeks with a repeat haemoglobin.
